verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents Automations as scheduled prompts that run at recurring times. Nothing in the evidence shows that automations can be versioned, have their changes reviewed, or be rolled back to an earlier definition. The repository changelog covers the product's own releases, and the git worktrees page covers parallel agent tasks; neither is versioning of a user's automations, so neither is credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
